ablation.name: phase4g1a_lock_ll
ablation.notes: Phase 4G.1a: True LL lock in inference. Trains with w_ll=1.0 (backbone sees LL target), but at inference skips v_ll application (ll_new = ll_old). Distinct from 4A2 (w_ll=0 only removed gradient but still applied random v_ll in inference). Tests core hypothesis: LL drift necessary or not? 2x2 matrix: (w_ll, lock_ll) = (1.0,false)=4F SOTA, (0.0,false)=4A2 fail, (1.0,true)=THIS, (0.0,true)=4G.1b.
